interpretation: The SGMC raster scores AUC ~ 1.0 against an SGMC-derived truth. That is the definition of leakage, and it is why this submission's PROXY-DTI is reported as a circular self-consistency check and never as a score. Any candidate whose evidence layer feeds the holdout truth cannot be validated on that holdout.
